title: Route expense approvals up a management chain
description: Expenses are approved by the first handler in the chain whose limit covers the amount: Manager (up to $500), Director (up to $5000), CEO (any amount). Each handler holds a reference to the next handler and passes the request on if it cannot approve it. Implement the three handlers so they can be chained together.
hints: ExpenseHandler is an abstract class with a setNext() method and an approve() method to implement
Each concrete handler compares the expense amount to its limit and either approves or calls next.approve()
If there is no next handler and the amount exceeds all limits, throw an IllegalStateException
issues: Without a chain, a single approval method needs a long if/else tree that must be updated whenever limits change
Adding a new approval tier means modifying the central dispatcher rather than just inserting a new handler
overallGoal: Use the Chain of Responsibility pattern so each handler only knows its own limit and its successor, and approval requests flow automatically to the right level.
goals: Define an abstract ExpenseHandler with setNext() and a handle() method
Implement Manager, Director, and CEO each approving their range and forwarding the rest to the next handler
Chain the handlers and throw an exception for any request that no handler approves
